name: Sign-in of a new user or from a new address
description: A successful Windows sign-in (interactive, network, remote desktop, unlock, cached) of a user from an address or workstation (the combination) that no device had in the last 10 days. Can be unauthorized access with stolen credentials or lateral movement.
message: {User} signed in from {Source}, not seen in the last 10 days ({Message})
remediation: Check that the sign-in was expected: who uses this account from that address or workstation. Reset the password and review the account if not.
